clayresearch.delta: Treat dependency resolution, semantic graph identity, trust/freshness, build provenance and capability authority as distinct planes. Ecosystem convergence is supporting analogy, not direct ClayCode proof.

frank.delta: FRANK build/replay/deployment receipts should pin BuildProjectionId and ArtifactHash; current trust policy separately gates admissibility. Package presence or declared effects never grant FRANK runtime capability authority.

gwt.delta: Adaptive recurrence/compute-routing experiments should pin dependency/build projection and artifact identities so observed loop behavior is not confounded by package/toolchain drift.

emergenz.delta: Dependency graph, build projection and artifact drift are causal confounds. Emergence/intervention experiments should pin these identities or explicitly treat build drift as an intervention.

claycode.delta: Implement a typed package-lock/provenance layer with PackageRequestId, ResolutionReceipt, ResolvedGraphId, BuildProjectionId, SupplyChainTrustReceipt and BuildProvenanceReceipt. First realize this in module/package/toolchain records/canonicalization/validation; no core syntax change is justified yet.

hyperposition.delta: Target/features/markers form a context-conditioned build projection, but this package result is not evidence for cognitive Hyperposition or higher-order emergence. Preserve the evidence-class boundary.

claygraph.delta: Represent exact package/dependency/provenance lineage as typed graph structure while keeping mutable trust/freshness overlay separate from semantic graph identity. Provenance connectivity does not imply truth, activation or admissibility.

unifieddb.delta: Persist PackageRequest, ResolutionReceipt, ResolvedGraph, TrustReceipt, BuildProjection and BuildReceipt as linked typed entities with immutable historical identity and mutable policy/admissibility state. This does not imply physical store consolidation.

harness.delta: Golden traces and differential/replay runs should bind exact package graph, build projection, compiler/runtime/backend identity, artifact hash and trust receipt. Add frozen-lock, registry-growth, artifact-mutation, mirror, resolver-equivalence, target-feature and authority-lesion cases on Ubuntu.

anti_echo: External standards are independent architectural analogies; the executable package_lock_probe.py is authored by this worker and therefore shares this run's oracle/assumptions. It cannot serve as independent replication.
